hero.purpose: The name in the hero only; last name italic in live signal orange, as in the approved comp.

display.purpose: Chapter headings with one italic closing clause.

lede.purpose: Chapter intros and contact paragraph, stone muted, 52ch max.

body.purpose: Summaries and step bodies, stone muted, 48 to 56ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked mono for running heads, tabs, nav, buttons, chips, metadata.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and animation; GSAP uses expo.out.

motion.name: enter
motion.value: rise-in 1.1s ease-out-expo; from opacity 0, translateY(0.35em), blur(6px); delay i * 90ms + 120ms
motion.purpose: First-viewport entrance in CSS, runs from first paint.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.value: scaleX(0) to 1 from the left, 1.4s ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Header and hero rules drawing in.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: GSAP: opacity 0 to 1, y 32px to 0, 1s expo.out, stagger 0.08s, ScrollTrigger.batch start 'top 88%', once
motion.purpose: Below-the-fold [data-reveal] elements in About; only those offscreen at mount are hidden.

motion.name: reveal-landing
motion.value: GSAP: from opacity 0, y -40px, blur(12px) to rest, 0.9s power3.out, stagger 0.12s, ScrollTrigger.batch start 'top 88%'; on leave-back lifts back to the start state, 0.5s power2.in
motion.purpose: [data-reveal] elements from Journey onward (Journey, Selected work, How I work, Contact).

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on hover.

motion.name: graph-draw
motion.value: primary route drawn over 1.6s after 0.5s with ease-out cubic, then one pulse loops at 0.22 cycles/s

motion.name: journey-stack
motion.value: pinned, scrubbed (0.8s) for 65vh per milestone on 1024px+ wide and 640px+ tall, reversing on scroll up; each row descends from -28vh out of blur(12px), hairline draws from the left, node pops (back.out) with a signal flash cooling to ink, year/title/body fade down 28px from blur(6px) staggered 0.1; year below dims to stone muted; spine scales up from the base; certifications fade down last. Narrow or short: spine scrubs down the list, rows entering together land 0.28s apart with the same landing (40px drop) and reverse on leave-back

focus.purpose: Global focus-visible ring; tightens to a small radius on square controls (tabs, panels, disclosure row).

selection.purpose: Text selection, one of the sanctioned live-signal uses.

motionPreference.value: root data-motion="on|off" set before first paint from prefers-reduced-motion; no on-page toggle
motionPreference.purpose: Every animation opts out under data-motion=off or prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.css: .ds-tower { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-tower::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 3px; width: 1px; background: rgb(241 235 229 / 0.28); } .ds-tower-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 146px minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.5fr); align-items: baseline; column-gap: 36px; padding: 14px 0 14px 50px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(241 235 229 / 0.14); } .ds-tower-node { position: absolute; left: 0; top: calc(14px + 19px - 3px); width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f1ebe5; } .ds-tower-year { margin: 0; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 38px; line-height: 1; color: #f1ebe5; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tower-past { color: #a6a39d; } .ds-tower-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', 'Times New Roman', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.1; color: #f1ebe5; } .ds-tower-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; color: #a6a39d; } .ds-tower-next .ds-tower-year { font-style: italic; color: #817e79; } .ds-tower-next .ds-tower-title { font-style: italic; color: #a6a39d; } .ds-tower-next .ds-tower-node { background: #080808; border: 1px solid #817e79; box-sizing: border-box; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a long magazine feature printed on black: one subject, told in numbered chapters, with a serif voice large enough to carry the page on its own. Density is low and deliberate. Each chapter opens on a very large Instrument Serif heading whose second clause turns italic, and everything around it (running heads, metadata, buttons) drops to small, tracked DM Mono so the serif never competes with itself.

Structure comes from hairline rules at low ink opacity, not from boxes, fills, or shadows. Featured work is laid out as ruled editorial rows rather than a grid of equal cards. The only colour with a temperature beyond the warm off-white ink is a single orange, and it is reserved for things that are live: the lit path through the hero's retrieval graph, text selection, the focus ring, and the caret.

The one moving image is the live retrieval graph in the hero: ink nodes and edges whose weight fades toward the field's rim, with an orange route that draws itself on load and a second ink route that links as the visitor scrolls. Motion elsewhere is quiet: a staggered blur-rise for the first viewport, opacity-and-lift reveals below the fold, and labels that roll on hover. All of it switches off under prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, warm off-white ink, two stepped greys; one orange for live signals only.
Instrument Serif at a single weight (400) for every heading, with one italic clause per headline.
DM Mono, uppercase and tracked, for every label, folio, nav item, and button.
Hairline rules and pill outlines carry all structure; no shadows, no filled cards.
A margin rail on wide screens holds chapter running heads, aligned with the header nav.
Layout measured in comp units (1 unit = 1px of a 1280-wide comp), fluid with the viewport.

rules.name: The Live Wire Rule
rules.body: Orange means "live." It appears on the graph's active path, selection, focus, and caret, and never on headings, italics, body text, borders, or decoration. The one exception is the italic last name in the hero headline, which matches the approved comp.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy is carried by warm ink, stone muted, and ash faint, in that order. Do not introduce a new hue to separate levels; drop a step instead.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px rules at 14% ink (hairline) or 28% ink (hairline-strong). The hero proof strip's vertical dividers sit between them at 20% ink.

rules.name: The One Italic Clause Rule
rules.body: Each serif headline carries exactly one italic clause, and it closes the line. Italic also marks quoted results, margin asides, and things that have not happened yet; it is never coloured.

rules.name: The Single Weight Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif runs at 400 only. Hierarchy comes from size and italic, never from bolding the serif.

rules.name: The Mono Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: DM Mono is always uppercase, tracked, and small. It labels; it never carries a sentence of prose. Numbers in labels and stats use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Margin Rail Rule
rules.body: On wide screens, chapter running heads live in the 32.66vw margin rail and stay sticky beside the content; they never sit as a label above the heading.

rules.name: The Flat Night Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If an element needs separation, give it a hairline or a tonal step, never an offset or glow.

dos: Do keep orange (live-signal) to the graph's live path, selection, focus, and caret.
Do give every serif headline one italic closing clause, in warm ink.
Do set every label, folio, nav item, button, and chip in uppercase tracked DM Mono at label size.
Do divide content with hairline rules (14% or 28% ink) and lay out work as ruled rows.
Do place chapter running heads in the 32.66vw margin rail from 1024px, and under the heading below that.
Do size layout in comp units (`100vw / 1280`) clamped with px floors and ceilings.
Do ship content visible in the server HTML; animate only offscreen `[data-reveal]` elements, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion` on every animation.
Do keep ash faint (about 4.96:1) as the lightest-contrast text; never go dimmer for readable copy.
donts: Don't put eyebrow kickers or small mono labels above headings. The hero's role and location lines are a one-off approved by the user from the comp, not a reusable device.
Don't number tabs or prefix them with ordinals.
Don't add shadows, glows, backdrop blurs, or filled cards to separate content.
Don't colour italics, headings, or body text orange.
Don't bold Instrument Serif or introduce another display face.
Don't use icon fonts or glyph icons; draw icons as inline SVG with a 1.25 stroke.
Don't round structural elements; radius belongs to pill controls only.
